data.long_description:
Provident Estate is delighted to present this brand-new 3-bedroom apartment in Park Field, one of the latest residential projects in Dubai Hills Estate. Nestled within a vibrant, green community, this home offers direct access to Dubai Hills Park and is just 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Palm Jumeirah.

Enjoy a perfect balance of modern living, family-friendly amenities, and serene surroundings. The area features an array of shopping, dining, and leisure options within walking distance, while the building itself boasts premium finishes and contemporary architecture that seamlessly blends with the lush park views.

Property Details:

3 Bedrooms
4 Bathrooms
Spacious Living Area with Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Master Bedroom with Walk-in Closet
Storage Room
Balcony with Full Park View

Experience elegant, park-side living at its finest.

Contact Provident Estate today to arrange a viewing and discover your new home in Dubai Hills Estate.
